limitations: Single timed128-output screens are not repeated512-output qualifications.

native_cpu_bias_micro_selection.protocol: Three balanced samples,16discarded calls and64timed calls each;64MiB rotating code set;activation quantization/model execution excluded. Eligible only if both M1 matrices improve >=3% and all M1/2/4/8 matrices regress <=5%; rank by geometric mean across both matrices at widths1/2/4. Quartets diagnostic only; no large metadata cache retry.

native_cpu_local_micro_selection.protocol: Three balanced samples,16discarded products and64timed products each;16products perpoolwake/four timedwakes,64MiB rotating code set;activation quantization/model execution excluded. native_cpu_policy_comparisons.scope: 3fullwarmups+3timed512 requests per variant. Exact CPU per-width dispatch only; mild route affinity held fixed. No preset change.
